Standard Operating Procedure

Purchase Order

Steps

  1. Click on the Create Purchase order button
  2. Click on the Add Item button
  3. Search and Select your Item (Same process for multiple item selection)
  4. Click on the Next button
  5. Select your Supplier
  6. Select your P.O. Approval by
  7. Enter Purchase Quantity
  8. Select Expected Delivery Date
  9. Select and ADD Payment Terms
  10. Select and ADD TAX Ledgers
  11. Click on the Select button (If Multiple)
  12. Select your Delivery Address
  13. Click on the OK button
  14. Click on the Save button
  15. Click on the Yes button
